summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything (read-only):** I audited the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` (read/write), `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, the auth middleware, `db/auth.ts` session table, and the watchlist schema. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, everything I can verify statically looks *correctly wired*: - No localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlist data anywhere in the client. - Every read/write round-trips to the server with `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie is always sent.
